name: Journal
purpose: Write, organize and test your Kins' Journal Entries before adding them in Kindroid. Your Kin can also draft entries in chat for you to review.

actions.name: save_journal_entry
actions.description: Use when they ask you to write something down in your journal, or to remember a person, place, event or fact as a Journal Entry. It saves a draft they review in the Journal app.

title.description: A short name: the person, place or event.

entry.description: The entry: concise, third person, the facts you should recall later.

keyphrases.description: 1 to 8 specific phrases (2 to 50 characters) they would type when this matters, like a name or 'the cabin trip'. No common words.

global.description: true only for world lore shared by all Kins, not about you.

actions.name: read_journal
actions.description: Use when they ask what your journal says about someone or something, or whether there is already a journal entry for it.

query.description: The person, place, event or words to look up.
